tips.1: Tip: The pause button cannot pause the time passing at your desk.
tips.2: Tip: Headphones will not make you invisible, but they can make you look busy.
tips.3: Tip: After 50 repeats, the system quietly sympathizes with your feelings.
tips.4: Tip: If a song suddenly sounds better, you probably slept badly last night.
tips.5: Tip: Unplug the network cable. Local songs still will not ask for VIP.
tips.6: Tip: Skipping faster will not help you choose faster, but your fingers get exercise.
tips.7: Tip: Closing your eyes really can improve the sound, unless you are cycling.
tips.8: Tip: Turning up the volume cannot solve your problems, but it can cover a sigh.
tips.9: Tip: Maximum headphone volume will not make the drummer work harder.
tips.10: Tip: Good music never expires, unless your hard drive hits the floor.
tips.11: Tip: At 0% volume, music becomes remarkably difficult to hear.
tips.12: Tip: Wearing headphones backwards will not make rewinding even a second faster.
tips.13: Tip: Good music cannot walk into a folder by itself, unless you saved it there.
tips.14: Tip: Nodding to the beat will not speed up the song, but it feels nice.
tips.15: Tip: Skipping ten songs late at night means you probably just do not want to sleep.

items.4: [Common armor] Phone speaker: low attack power, high risk of public resentment.
items.5: [Epic relic] Turntable: radiates an aura that makes digital music seem impatient.
items.6: [Consumable] Blank cassette: a low-capacity storage chest for 1990s romance.
items.7: [Rare accessory] Adapter: a rune prone to vanishing into hidden backpack pockets.
items.8: [Legendary item] Open-back headphones: top-tier soundstage plus judgment from family.
items.9: [Cursed item] Cheap Bluetooth: chance to disconnect precisely at the climax.
items.10: [Standard equipment] Volume knob: clockwise increases the distance between you and the world.
items.11: [Armor] Over-ear cups: physically block the intrusion of "Got a minute?"

items.14: [Consumable] Damp cleaning cloth: reserved for compulsive album-cover polishing.
items.15: [Relic] 3.5mm jack: a legacy left to the present by an ancient civilization.

lore.1: Rumor: Loop a song a hundred times and you can hear the mixing engineer sigh.
lore.2: Library lore: Do not move "New Folder". It maintains the balance of the archive.
lore.3: Audiophile scripture: Masters heard at 2:30 AM usually have better resolution.
lore.4: Ancient record: The earliest vinyl buyers still have cat hair at home.
lore.5: Archive rumor: Some lossless tracks are huge because they seal away a bassist's soul.
lore.6: Archaeological find: The folder called "Preview (2)" is already ten years old.
lore.7: Tavern rumor: An obscure Japanese pressing hides the world's finest outro.
lore.8: Acoustic chronicle: Every extra 3dB reduces real-world rationality by 10%.
lore.9: Library lore: Some unplayed songs quietly preserve the completeness of a playlist.
lore.10: Ancient wisdom: A treasured CD lent to a friend often becomes a gift.
lore.11: Folklore: The first audiophiles could supposedly hear wind-generated electricity.
lore.12: Archive record: That grain on the cover is the romance of its era, not a flaw.
lore.13: Old legend: A midnight bass slide possesses the power to soothe insomnia.
lore.14: Ancient rumor: Tracks that have visited the Recycle Bin tend to sound more world-weary.
lore.15: Library study: Some songs sit last because their outros are devastating.

patches.1: [Hotfix] Fixed a bug where some songs were too good to let users sleep on time.
patches.2: [Optimization] Improved skipping logic: bad songs can now be skipped 15% faster.
patches.3: [Balance] Nerfed the singer's excessive confidence. Buffed kick-drum penetration.
patches.4: [Bug fix] Fixed long intros being mistaken for broken headphones.
patches.5: [Core patch] Removed excessive compatibility with generic hits. Mind purified.
patches.6: [Optimization] Now supports looking busy processing audio while daydreaming at your desk.
patches.7: [Known issue] Currently unable to fix critical youth-memory damage caused by old songs.
patches.8: [Hotfix] Fixed headphone leakage exposing obscure playlists.
patches.9: [Patch 1.4] Increased the writing-focus bonus from instrumental accompaniment.
patches.10: [Emergency rollback] Reverted the feature that automatically shared your secret deep cuts.
patches.11: [Hotfix] Fixed goosebumps caused by excessively powerful choruses.
patches.12: [Balance] Increased pride in lossless files. Reduced download-speed anxiety.
patches.13: [Core patch] Fixed quiet intros being mistaken for a system freeze.
patches.14: [Experience] Local lossless playback now displays absolutely no subscription reminders.
patches.15: [Known issue] The system still cannot explain "Why is this song so short?"
